mapper.sql: p.id AS post_id, p.category AS category, p.title AS title, p.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, s.id AS spot_id, s.name AS spot_name, p.created_at AS created_at, p.updated_at AS updated_at
FROM community_post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id LEFT JOIN spot s ON s.id = p.spot_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select:
SELECT , p.content AS text
WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
